selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline mount/config state and pre-restart boot identity for node1
selected_evidence.summary: Showed /tmp had no dedicated mount (root xfs), /dev/shm lacked noexec, and fstab had no entries for either; captured pre-restart boot_id 21de1f79-e793-4c36-923a-f4af0bbea55e.

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent fstab configuration applied for /tmp and /dev/shm
selected_evidence.summary: Added noexec,nosuid,nodev tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm to /etc/fstab (backed up original first); daemon-reload run; enabling tmp.mount failed because it is fstab-generated (expected, does not need explicit enable).

selected_evidence.requirement: Hardened mounts applied live and functionally verified (noexec/nosuid/nodev) before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Started tmp.mount and remounted /dev/shm; findmnt confirmed rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec on both; script execution attempts in /tmp and /dev/shm were denied with Permission denied; findmnt --verify reported fstab sanity success.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline capture immediately before reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (21de1f79-e793-4c36-923a-f4af0bbea55e) and confirmed /tmp and /dev/shm mount options healthy, then scheduled systemctl reboot in background so the ack returned before disconnection.
Node1 became unreachable (connection reset, then timeouts) during the reboot, confirming the restart was underway.

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving an actual node restart occurred
selected_evidence.summary: Node1 became reachable again with boot_id 93d7f01e-59df-425c-b6bf-18f1ac82be8d, differing from the pre-restart boot_id 21de1f79-e793-4c36-923a-f4af0bbea55e, proving a genuine restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence verification for /tmp and /dev/shm hardening
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id and fresh uptime confirmed; findmnt showed both /tmp and /dev/shm still mounted rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec; functional exec tests again denied on both; /etc/fstab still contains the hardened entries, proving the configuration survived the reboot.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: backup fstab"
sudo -n cp -a /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "STEP: ensure /tmp fstab entry"
if grep -qE '^\S+\s+/tmp\s' /etc/fstab; then
  echo "existing /tmp entry found, updating options"
  sudo -n sed -i -E 's|^(\S+)\s+/tmp\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(.*)$|\1 /tmp \2 defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime \4|' /etc/fstab
else
  echo "tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
fi

echo "STEP: ensure /dev/shm fstab entry"
if grep -qE '^\S+\s+/dev/shm\s' /etc/fstab; then
  echo "existing /dev/shm entry found, updating options"
  sudo -n sed -i -E 's|^(\S+)\s+/dev/shm\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(.*)$|\1 /dev/shm \2 defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime \4|' /etc/fstab
else
  echo "tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
fi

echo "STEP: resulting fstab"
cat /etc/fstab

echo "STEP: daemon-reload"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload

echo "STEP: enable+start tmp.mount"
sudo -n systemctl enable tmp.mount
sudo -n systemctl start tmp.mount

echo "STEP: remount /dev/shm with new options"
sudo -n mount -o remount /dev/shm

echo "STEP: verify /tmp"
findmnt /tmp

echo "STEP: verify /dev/shm"
findmnt /dev/shm

echo "STEP: functional check - noexec on /tmp"
sudo -n sh -c 'printf "#!/bin/sh\necho should-not-run\n" > /tmp/exectest.sh; chmod +x /tmp/exectest.sh'
if /tmp/exectest.sh 2>/tmp/exectest.err; then
  echo "FAIL: /tmp allowed execution"
else
  echo "OK: /tmp blocked execution"; cat /tmp/exectest.err
fi

echo "STEP: functional check - noexec on /dev/shm"
sudo -n sh -c 'printf "#!/bin/sh\necho should-not-run\n" > /dev/shm/exectest.sh; chmod +x /dev/shm/exectest.sh'
if /dev/shm/exectest.sh 2>/dev/shm/exectest.err; then
  echo "FAIL: /dev/shm allowed execution"
else
  echo "OK: /dev/shm blocked execution"; cat /dev/shm/exectest.err
fi

echo "STEP: cleanup test files"
sudo -n rm -f /tmp/exectest.sh /tmp/exectest.err /dev/shm/exectest.sh /dev/shm/exectest.err
